notes.title: Temporal Cross - 2025 New Release Festival Special Edition [English]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119660/5ca2d1552c5e62fd6b75f10f8ef1334f14681f27.png
Dear time travelers,

We are thrilled to announce that "Temporal Cross" will make its appearance at the Steam New Product Festival on February 24th. Since our last successful preliminary test, we've eagerly awaited our next gathering. We deeply appreciate every participant; your valuable feedback and suggestions are crucial for our continuous improvement.

▌ Update Highlights

✦ Comprehensive Character System Optimization 
We've retained the three initial characters that players love and introduced new deck-building routes for each, significantly enriching the gameplay diversity.

✦ Completely Redesigned Beginner's Guide 
We've removed the requirement for repeated logins to view tutorials and added detailed operation guides, allowing new players to freely explore the world of the game.

✦ More Detailed Level Design 
The game's levels have been expanded to four layers, each containing various room types. Upon successfully unlocking all rooms, players will have the opportunity to discover exciting hidden rooms.

▌ Special Thanks Event

In gratitude for participants from 2024 and 2025, we offer all veteran players a 30% discount on the official version to thank you for your early support and contributions.

▌ We Are Eager to Hear Your Voice

We hope to use the New Product Festival as a significant platform to let more players experience the unique charm of "Temporal Cross." Please provide your valuable feedback and suggestions through the “Important Links” below. We take every opinion seriously and look forward to optimizing this game with you.

Please remember, the current display is just a test version and not the final product. To iterate updates faster, we've chosen the simplest way to showcase game content so we can focus on perfecting the gameplay. Look forward to our official version, which will offer a more complete and enriching gaming experience.

Thank you for your support and understanding. We are looking forward to meeting each player again at the New Product Festival!

▌ Important Links

Download the Game: Ready to dive in? Click here to download the game and start your adventure!

Gameplay & Content Discussion: Have questions about how to play, game mechanics, or want to discuss the story? Join the conversation here! We’d love to hear your thoughts and help with any questions.

Bug Reports & Feedback: Encountered any bugs or technical issues? Click here to report them. Your feedback is crucial, and we’ll be updating our FAQ regularly based on your input.

notes.title: Open Game Demo - October 2024 [English]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119660/72833f3b5687e83db2fb38a46cecfa32c6427417.png

Hey there, players! We're glad you’re giving our game a shot. We're genuinely excited to have you here and are looking forward to your honest thoughts. Whether it’s something you love or something that doesn’t quite hit the mark, your feedback will help us make the game better. So dive in, explore, and share what works and what doesn't. We hope you enjoy the game—thanks for being a part of this journey!

Initial Commit

This demo includes three starting characters, with two more hidden characters that you can unlock after completing the 3rd and 5th playthroughs. We can't wait to see how you'll uncover them!

[table]
[tr]
    [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119660/ae38fd37d677e11e4faf4595f9c63486d5ef24a4.png[/td]
    [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119660/e43a7adc13fa82f58417de0a0421517fb81a467e.png[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

If you’d like to revisit the tutorial scene, you can log out and choose a new username. For a quick overview of the rules, just click the "?" button in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119660/a64ba896fc9dbd7c11ac05d1acfc394b4e88cae3.png

Our game currently supports English, Simplified / Traditional Chinese, and Japanese. Please note that some languages might have minor consistency issues. If you run into any problems, don’t hesitate to leave a reply with your feedback—feel free to use any language you’re comfortable with. 

We truly appreciate your support and help! :)
